usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/search with JSON body {"query":"<search question string>"}

inputExample.query: What is the latest news about AI today?

usage.outputShape: body.summary (markdown answer string with inline [n](url) citation links), body.citations[] (often empty), body.sources_used (int), body.model (e.g. "xai/grok-3-mini"), body.query (echo)
quirks: Body field MUST be {"query":"..."} as a single string — NOT {"messages":[...]} or {"text":...}. Wrong shape returns a FREE 400 with a zod error 'expected string ... path: query'.

The actual answer is in body.summary as markdown with inline [n](url) citation links; body.citations[] was returned empty even with sources_used=10 — parse links out of summary if you need source URLs.
x402 payment on Base; observed cost $0.2625 per call (usage/token-dynamic, varies).
usage.guide: Send POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/search with JSON body {"query":"<your search question>"} — payment is automatic via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.26/call, varies). Do not use a messages array; the only field is the single string "query", otherwise you get a free 400. Read the answer from body.summary (markdown with inline numbered citation links); use body.sources_used and body.model for metadata. body.citations[] may be empty, so extract source URLs from the summary text if needed.
